flow.say: Want to talk about this together? I can take the other side, or just chat.
flow.note: 토론 방식은 학습자가 고름(헤니 검토 9). 반대편이 기본이 아님.

flow.say: Today’s question: {claim_en} What do you think?

flow.hint_ko: 도움 표현(선택): I partly agree, but… / The main reason is that…
flow.tori_after: I see. Here’s another way to look at it.

flow.note: ‘반대편’을 골랐을 때만 학습자 생각의 반대쪽 논거 하나. ‘같은 편’이면 같은 쪽 논거, ‘그냥 이야기’면 열린 질문 하나. 학습자가 실제 사정(건강·알레르기·돈·가족 등)을 이유로 말하면 반론하지 않고 ‘That makes sense.’ 뒤 열린 질문으로.

flow.hint_ko: 도움 표현(선택): I see your point, but… / For example, …
flow.tori_after: Good point. So what’s your final answer?

flow.hint_ko: 도움 표현(선택): Overall, I think… / It depends on…

flow.note: tip = 이번 과제에서 가장 쓸모 있는 표현 하나(친구 대화 교정 규칙과 같음: We usually say, "…"). 없으면 생략.

tasks.claim_en: Working from home is better than working at the office.
counter_for_agree: But at the office, it can be easier to share ideas quickly.
Some people feel lonely or work too late at home.
counter_for_disagree: But you save hours of commuting every week.
At home, you can focus without noisy coworkers.

tasks.claim_en: We still need to learn foreign languages, even with AI translators.
tasks.claim_ko: AI 번역기가 있어도 외국어는 배워야 한다.
counter_for_agree: But AI translators are fast, and many are getting better.
Some people only need a language for short trips.
counter_for_disagree: But talking without a translator can feel closer and more natural.
Translators can miss jokes and feelings.

tasks.claim_en: A four-day work week is a good idea.
counter_for_agree: But some places need people every day, so schedules can get tricky.
People might work longer hours on the other four days.
counter_for_disagree: But rested workers often do better work.
A long weekend gives time for family and hobbies.

tasks.claim_en: We won’t need cash in ten years.
counter_for_agree: But some older people still feel safer with cash.
If the network goes down, some card payments may not work.
counter_for_disagree: But most people already pay with phones and cards.
Cash is slow and easy to lose.

tasks.claim_en: Package tours are better than planning your own trip.
counter_for_agree: But on a package tour, you can’t choose where to stay longer.
You often spend time in shops you don’t need.
counter_for_disagree: But planning everything yourself takes a lot of time.
A guide can explain history you would miss.

counter_for_agree: But some shops pay people to write good reviews.
Angry customers write reviews more often than happy ones.
counter_for_disagree: But reading many reviews together can show a pattern.
Reviews can help you avoid really bad places.

tasks.claim_en: It’s better to live in the countryside when you get older.
tasks.claim_ko: 나이 들면 시골에 사는 게 낫다.
counter_for_agree: But hospitals and shops are far away in the countryside.
It can feel lonely without friends nearby.
counter_for_disagree: But the air is cleaner and life is slower.
Houses are cheaper, and you can grow vegetables.

tasks.claim_en: Children under twelve shouldn’t have smartphones.
counter_for_agree: But parents can call them anytime with a phone.
Kids can learn a lot from good apps.
counter_for_disagree: But many kids spend too many hours on screens.
Without phones, they play outside more.
tasks.note_ko: 육아 방식을 평가하지 않아요. 학습자가 부모인지 묻지 않아요.

tasks.claim_en: Social media makes people less happy.
counter_for_agree: But social media helps us keep in touch with old friends.
You can find people with the same hobbies.
counter_for_disagree: But people compare their lives with others’ best moments.
Scrolling for hours can make you feel tired.

tasks.claim_en: Everyone should try having a pet at least once.
tasks.claim_ko: 누구나 한 번쯤은 반려동물을 키워 봐야 한다.
counter_for_agree: But pets need a lot of time and money.
Some people are allergic or live in small homes.
counter_for_disagree: But pets can make people calmer and happier.
Caring for an animal teaches responsibility.
tasks.note_ko: 알레르기·돈·집 사정 같은 실제 이유를 말하면 토리는 반론하지 않아요. 건강 이야기는 기억에 남기지 않아요.
